accepted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native portrait mobile login-page background for the fictional cross-platform strategy game SHADOWGRID
Input images: Image 1 is the approved desktop login background and defines the architectural world, materials, and restrained gold lighting; Image 2 is an approved mobile composition reference. Create a new portrait composition rather than cropping either image.
Primary request: Create a premium ultra-realistic 9:16 portrait view through the same kind of calm, original contemporary corporate access atrium in a fictional German metropolis.
Scene/backdrop: vertically framed dark-stone and glass arrival space with brushed metal, a hint of exterior city light through side glazing, and physically plausible architecture; no identifiable location.
Subject: architecture only. The environment should suggest controlled institutional access and strategic scale without depicting any illicit activity.
Style/medium: ultra-realistic architectural photography; contemporary urban economic-strategy simulation; cinematic corporate-thriller atmosphere; restrained subtle cyber-noir; realistic material texture and reflections.
Composition/framing: native exact 9:16 portrait intent, intended final size 1152x2048; human eye-level vertical composition designed for a 320–600 px phone viewport. Keep the broad central area from about 8% to 92% width and 14% to 90% height darker, calm, and low-detail for the full login form. Confine the strongest architectural lines and warm highlights to the upper-right, extreme side edges, and lower background. Preserve a quiet upper-left region for the existing horizontal brand mark. Do not place a bright horizon, mullion, doorway edge, furniture, or focal object behind the form-safe center.
Lighting/mood: blue-hour ambient light with restrained warm-gold interior illumination; calm, secure, credible, serious but welcoming.
Color palette: black, anthracite, cool blue-gray, restrained warm gold; no saturated neon and no warning red.
Materials/textures: dark glass, brushed metal, concrete, stone, subtle floor grain; physically plausible scale.
Text: none.
Constraints: entirely original fictional architecture; no people or faces; no text, signs, screens, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, readable plates, addresses, flags, uniforms, authorities, weapons, crime symbols, or real brands. Maintain clear UI contrast at 320 px width and 200% zoom. Do not derive this by simply cropping the desktop reference.
Avoid: copied landmark-photo angles, impossible geometry, distorted buildings, floating elements, excessive neon, cartoon, anime, comic, plastic mobile-game rendering, blur, low resolution, compression artifacts, fake writing.
notes: This is a native portrait composition, not a crop of the desktop asset.
The broad central form-safe area remains calm and low-detail at phone widths.
No visible person, text, logo, private identifier, authority mark, weapon or illicit activity.
